question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing right midfielder, Claire is playing right back, Dave is playing center midfielder, Eve is playing left midfielder, Fred is playing goalkeeper, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Fred trade positions. Then, Dave and Fred trade positions. Then, Alice and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Finally, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) right midfielder
(C) right back
(D) center midfielder
(E) left midfielder
(F) goalkeeper
(G) right winger
solution:
Each row lists the positions of (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude), in that order.
Initial: (fullback, right midfielder, right back, center midfielder, left midfielder, goalkeeper, right winger)
1. Dave ↔ Fred: (fullback, right midfielder, right back, goalkeeper, left midfielder, center midfielder, right winger)
2. Dave ↔ Fred: (fullback, right midfielder, right back, center midfielder, left midfielder, goalkeeper, right winger)
3. Alice ↔ Bob: (right midfielder, fullback, right back, center midfielder, left midfielder, goalkeeper, right winger)
4. Claire ↔ Dave: (right midfielder, fullback, center midfielder, right back, left midfielder, goalkeeper, right winger)
5. Dave ↔ Eve: (right midfielder, fullback, center midfielder, left midfielder, right back, goalkeeper, right winger)
6. Bob ↔ Eve: (right midfielder, right back, center midfielder, left midfielder, fullback, goalkeeper, right winger)
7. Dave ↔ Gertrude: (right midfielder, right back, center midfielder, right winger, fullback, goalkeeper, left midfielder)
Eve is playing fullback, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
